independence: Round 2: each role filled by fresh claude-opus-5-5 sessions that sat on no earlier jury and drafted nothing (subject x3, safety x2, language x2), each given only its own role's work orders and barred from every other role's orders, verdicts and the earlier round; verdicts combined only by jury run after all seven finished. The redrafts were written by separate claude-fable-5 sessions that sat on no jury.

notes: subject: hints-fair - the hint ('帖子、图片和文章，哪一个能让你知道是谁写的、什么时候写的？') restates the exact words of option c ('有作者和日期的文章'), so the child can match keywords instead of reasoning; it gives the answer away.

subject: explanation-correct - the hint frames the choice as post vs picture vs article, implying the kind of medium decides credibility; what matters is whether an author and date are shown (and whether other sources agree), not that it is an 'article'. Misleading.

claims.claim: Checking authorship, date and other sources and telling fact from opinion are how children evaluate online content; the keyed answer '有作者和日期的文章' is the only sound choice.
